Rajesh Singh Rajput vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 July,
2022
Author: Anjuli Palo

Bench: Anjuli Palo
In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Crr No. 2428 of 2022 (Rajesh
Singh Rajput Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) Dated : 08-07-2022 Shri P.S. Tomar,
counsel for the applicant.

entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri C.M. Tiwari, Ga for the State.
Heard on I.A. No.12184/2022, which is an application filed on behalf of the applicant for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The applicant has been convicted by the trial Court under Sections 7(i)
(iii), 16(1)(a)(ii) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 6 months with fine of Rs. 2,000/- and till rising of the Court with fine of Rs. 500/- respectively with default stipulation.

The aforesaid conviction and sentence has been affirmed by the lower appellate Court Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the trial Court has n o t properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record.
Maximum sentence awarded to the applicant is six months.
The applicant is in custody and disposal of this revision will take considerable time, therefore, the jail sentence of the applicant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.
Learned Govt. Advocate has opposed the application.

Looking to the nature of allegation against the applicant and period of jail sentence awarded to the applicant, I find it to be a fit case to suspend the custodial sentence of the applicant and to release him on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, this application is allowed.

I t is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned, the custodial sentence of applicant Rajesh Singh Rajput shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail for securing his presence before the trial Court concerned on 2.12.2022 and on such other dates as may be fixed in this regard.
